_comment_http: Dashboard + JSON API. 127.0.0.1 keeps it on this machine only; use 0.0.0.0 to expose it to your network.
_comment_db: SQLite database file, relative to where you run the bridge
_comment_udp: UDP port the bridge listens on (ESP32 sends vitals here)
_comment_node: Default node identifier when not specified via --node-id
_comment_batch: How many seconds of samples to buffer before writing one batch row
_comment_live: How often (seconds) to update live vitals
_comment_apnea_bpm: Breathing rate below this (BPM) is considered apneic
_comment_apnea_dur: BR must stay below threshold for this many seconds to confirm an apnea event
_comment_idle: Seconds of stillness before the bridge fires an idle event
_comment_bands: Motion-energy bands for room state. PROVISIONAL — measured over 55s on one ESP32-C6 in a daytime room (min 0.7, median 8.5, p90 23.2, max 35.8). Real CSI energy is nothing like the simulator's 0-1 range. Tune these from your own overnight data: run with --verbose and watch the motion column while the room is empty, then while you are in bed. Set 'quiet' just above your empty-room reading.
_comment_fallvar: Variance of the last 5 motion samples that flags elevated fall risk. Also scale-dependent, also provisional.
_comment_session: One bridge run = one night. Restarting within this many seconds rejoins the previous session instead of splitting the night in two.

simulation._comment_rate: Simulated sample rate in Hz (1.0 = one packet per second)
simulation._comment_apnea: Per-second probability of starting a simulated apnea event. 0.002 gives a realistic handful per hour; higher values make every night look severe.
